messages:
matt: incident-bot paged about sustained inference_p95 > 500ms in us-west1 around 12:03 UTC. customers hitting timeouts, some 504s. can oncall confirm impact?

sre-bot: Pager sent to eng-sre-oncall (jun). alert: inference_p95_us-west1 > 500ms for 6m. link: https://monitoring.redwood/api/alerts/ALRT-9876

jun: seeing it. tail latency spiking for the runner pool that serves v1.3 models. CPU on hosts looks fine, GPU queue depth high. tracing shows long KV-cache misses.

matt: any quick mitigations? can we route to warm pool or fallback smaller model?

jun: I toggled routing policy to prefer local dedicated nodes with spare capacity, and enabled fallback to v1.2 (smaller). Doing a canary shift now.

ola: nice. customer impact reduced within ~90s. error rate dropping. we should still do a postmortem and tune alerts — too noisy and didn't give useful drilldowns.

tess: +1 on noise. the alert came as a single p95 metric without breakdown by model/route/host. hard to triage. for retrospectives we should add panel drilldowns in Grafana to isolate model-level p95, queue depth, and routing policy.

nik: proposing a retrospective dashboard for these incidents. panels: overall golden signals (p50/p95/p99 latency, error rate, rps), runner queue depth, KV cache miss rate, model routing distribution, and per-host GPU utilization. also link to the runbook and recent deploys.

ops-runbooks-bot: Runbook referenced: https://docs.redwood/internal/runbooks/inference-tail-latency.md. last updated: 2025-11-02.

matt: for alerts, we should change the p95 alert to be an aggregation with a label_filter, e.g., only fire if p95 > 500ms for model:v1.3 and region:us-west1 OR if cluster-wide p95 > 650ms. reduces noisy flapping.

jun: agreed. also add a secondary alert for queue_depth > 1000 on any runner group for 3m. that signaled backlog earlier but we didn't have it.

tess: on the dashboard UI, I'd like drilldown links on each panel that open a query with pre-filled tag filters. e.g. click p95 -> opens panel showing p95 by model then by host. Grafana supports dashboard links with variables.

nik: draft panels and queries I used during the pager (copying here):
```
// overall latency panel (PromQL)
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(inference_latency_bucket[1m])) by (le, model, region))
// queue depth
sum(runner_queue_depth) by (runner_group)
// kv cache miss rate
rate(kv_cache_miss_total[1m]) / rate(kv_cache_requests_total[1m])
```

ola: action items: 1) nik to create grafana dashboard PR with panels + drilldown links (owner nik). 2) matt/jun to update alert rules (p95 aggregation + queue_depth alert) and add annotations for the incident window. 3) tess to update the runbook with routing mitigation steps and thresholds. 4) ops-runbooks-bot to schedule runbook review.

matt: timeline: let's get the dashboard PR up today for review — we can iterate on visuals. alert changes should be staged in dev for 24h before prod commit.

nik: starting the dashboard branch now: "infra/incident-retro-grafana/1769991234". will include JSON model and dashboard variables: region, model, runner_group, route_policy.

jun: oncall handoff: I'm going offline at 12:25 UTC, handing to ola for next hour. @ola please watch the new fallback routing metrics.

ola: taking it. will monitor queue_depth and p95 by model. will post updates if anything flares.

ops-runbooks-bot: Runbook review meeting created: 2026-03-18 15:00 UTC. Invite sent to @matt @jun @tess @nik @ola.

matt: quick notes for the dashboard review: prioritize clarity over lots of panels. top row: golden signals + incident annotation. second row: model breakdown + routing distribution. third row: infra signals (queue, GPU, KV cache). include export link to CSV for retro analysis.

nik: ack. I'll ping when PR is ready and include screenshots.

ola: thanks all. glad fallback worked, but let's reduce time-to-mitigation with better dashboards and tuned alerts. :thumbsup:
